`final class ShaderSource`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderSource.java)

One stage of a shader written in JOID GLSL, parsed so that every backend can translate it.

## Description

A source is a GLSL body in the dialect of JOID: [Write JOID GLSL](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/#write-joid-glsl) gives its rules and its built-in names.
Parsing drops the `#version` line and the `in`, `out` and `uniform` declarations, which the translator writes again for each backend, and notes the built-in names and the [`ShaderFeature`](/reference/pipeline/shaderfeature/)s that the code uses.
A [`ShaderProgram`](/reference/shaders/shaderprogram/) reads both of its stages for you.

## Learn more

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#from-source-to-program)

## Creation details

<a id="ShaderSource-factory-from"></a>

### from

`ShaderSource from(ShaderStage stage, String code)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Parses a source from its code.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when a vertex source declares an `in` variable (read the built-in attributes instead) or a fragment source declares an `out` variable (write the color to `fragColor`).

<a id="ShaderSource-factory-read"></a>

### read

`ShaderSource read(ShaderStage stage, Object handle)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `UncheckedIOException`: …

Reads and parses a source from anything that [`Asset.of`](/reference/resources/asset/#Asset-factory-of) opens: a `File`, an `InputStream` such as a classpath resource, a URL, an [`Asset`](/reference/resources/asset/).
Throws `UncheckedIOException` when the source cannot be read, and `IllegalArgumentException` as `from` does.

<a id="ShaderSource-method-toLine"></a>

### toLine

`ShaderSource toLine()` 

Returns the line variant of a vertex source: the same code, run twice per vertex by a wrapper that widens each segment into a quad of the line width.
The core calls it to build the line shader of a shader; your own shaders never need it.

<a id="ShaderSource-method-getStage"></a>

### getStage

`ShaderStage getStage()` 

Returns the stage that the source was parsed for.

<a id="ShaderSource-method-getBody"></a>

### getBody

`String getBody()` 

Returns the code without the `#version` line and without the declarations.
Each removed line stays as an empty line, so the line numbers of a compiler error match the source.

<a id="ShaderSource-method-isLine"></a>

### isLine

`boolean isLine()` 

If `true`, the source comes from `toLine()`.
